title: A sales pipeline where every stage has a next step.
body: I built stage-by-stage follow-up in HubSpot for a B2B ingredient business, from first inquiry to first order.
detail: B2B deals here move slowly: inquiry, samples, product development, a signed agreement, then a first order. Each stage now has its own follow-up, so no lead waits on someone remembering it.

sections.label: THE PROBLEM
sections.copy: Follow-up depended on memory. When a lead stalled after samples or during development, nothing prompted the next touch, and reports did not show where deals were actually stuck.

sections.label: WHAT I BUILT
sections.copy: A pipeline with clear stages from inquiry to first order, plus a dedicated email sequence for each stage. When a contact moves stages, the right follow-up starts. When the sender left the company, I moved the sequences over without breaking them.

sections.label: THE RESULT
sections.copy: Every open lead has a stage and a next touch. I report on the funnel monthly for the sales meeting, so the team sees where deals slow down.

sections.label: NOTE
sections.copy: Live work, summarized without company records, rules, or screenshots.
